newsitem.title: INDIA: India's NSE asks members to declare long positions.
newsitem.headline: India's NSE asks members to declare long positions.

text.p: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) on Wednesday asked members to declare their long positions in shares with immediate effect.
"It is mandatory for all members to declare all long buy orders at the time of order entry on the system," NSE said in a notice to its members.

NSE said "long buy" referred to "buying the shares without having the intention of taking the physical delivery of the shares in the same settlement and in the same stock exchange unless it is for squaring up an earlier short-sale position in the same settlement and in the same stock exchange."
Market regulator the Securities and Exchange Board of India said last month it had asked exchanges to ensure their members declared daily long positions.
